about: The OxyOS shell (apps/shell) in one window of the Bloom host (sample/ShellProbe.tsx), a first native step: it renders only once react-native-safe-area-context's provider reports its insets, which the host now does (zero, an OxyOS window has none). The top bar's menus and the wallpaper are drawn. Not yet: the shell as shell surfaces with the compositor's windows and workspaces, react-native-svg, react-native-gesture-handler and Intl (docs/bloom-native-audit.mdx).

steps.name: a press on the empty desktop changes nothing: the wallpaper stays
